text_block_list.text:
After having a nightmare about losing the 
Japanese Derby, Winning Ticket grew 
anxious and ended up overtraining.

Questioned by her worried Trainer, she 
opened up about her anxiety, confessing, 
"I'm scared of running in the Derby."

Through their conversation, the Trainer 
realized she desired victory more than 
anyone, and told her that strong 
conviction would become her greatest 
weapon.

Greatly encouraged, Winning Ticket wielded 
those feelings as her weapon, shouting 
into the night sky that she would 
definitely win the Nippon Derby.
